description: Kiara Reserve Residences is a branded beachfront condominium by Minor International at Layan Beach in Phuket, adjacent to the Anantara Layan resort and managed with Anantara. The condominium building has 5 floors and 25 units in three- and four-bedroom layouts, including duplexes and penthouses. Built-up areas run from about 251 sqm upward, with owners able to join a rental programme.
